tool_input.command: git stash push -- app routes .guren >/dev/null && bun test tests/PostArchiveController.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -5; git stash pop
tool_input.description: Verify new tests fail on the unfixed code

result:
Both `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` pass (8 tests across 3 files; the stack traces printed during the run are the pre-existing framework logging of handled 422s).

The root cause was the route pattern `/posts/archive/:date*` in `routes/web.ts:35` — Hono (the router under `@guren/core`) has no `:param*` catch-all syntax, so it registered a single-segment param literally named `date*`. That made `/posts/archive/2026/08` a 404 (two segments never matched) and `/posts/archive/2026` a 422 (the param arrived as `date*`, so `ArchiveParamSchema`'s required `date` was missing) — I reproduced both symptoms against Hono directly before changing anything. I replaced the catch-all with two explicit patterns, `/archive/:year/:month` (named `posts.archive.month`) and `/archive/:year` (`posts.archive`), both still registered before `/:id` and both pointing at the same `PostController.archive` action; `ArchiveParamSchema` in `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts` now validates `year` as four digits and an optional `month` matching `0?[1-9]|1[0-2]` (so `08` and `8` both pass and `13`/`00` get a 422), and `PostController.archive` reads those two params directly instead of splitting a combined string, keeping the existing `YYYY-MM-`/`YYYY-` LIKE prefix match on the stored UTC `created_at`. I regenerated `.guren/routes.gen.ts` and `.guren/api-client.gen.ts` with `bun run codegen`, and added `tests/PostArchiveController.test.ts`, which seeds posts in a sentinel year and covers month, no-leading-zero month, whole year, an empty period, and rejected month/year values.
